desc: Every data-channel frame type. msg is the JSON form (i64/u64 decimal strings, bytes hex); hex is the full wire frame.

vectors.name: hi_negative_tick
vectors.desc: i64 is signed: lastTick -1 means no state yet

vectors.name: frame_two_cmds
vectors.desc: commands in peerId then arrival order

vectors.name: hash
vectors.desc: FNV-1a 64 of an empty grid (all zero 256 bytes) at tick 20

vectors.name: desync
vectors.desc: host tells peer the two hashes

vectors.name: snapshot_header
vectors.desc: snapshot of tick 100, 260 bytes, not deflated

vectors.name: chunk_empty_body
vectors.desc: a chunk may carry zero bytes (empty payload = one empty chunk)

vectors.name: raw_broadcast
vectors.desc: raw payload, route 0 = broadcast / for host

vectors.name: pong
vectors.desc: echoes n and t of the ping

vectors.name: host_claim
vectors.desc: migration claim, epoch 1, new host 2, at tick 777

vectors.name: voice_two_packets
vectors.desc: speaker 3 (route), seq 9, two 20 ms frames, not end of burst

vectors.name: voice_end_of_burst
vectors.desc: flags bit0 = end of talk burst, one frame

vectors.name: chat_send
vectors.desc: sender -> host: id is the sender client counter, ts 0, host stamps both

vectors.name: pause_state_pauser_left
vectors.desc: host -> all: the pauser left, host (peer 1) holds the pause (flags bit 0)

vectors.name: raw_max_frame
vectors.desc: exactly 16384 bytes (the limit); body bytes all 0xab
